slots.title: Former NYSE president says stock issuers hold the key to tokenization as Bullish builds its platform
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: Stacey Cunningham, who recently joined digital asset platform Bullish as President, sees the company’s planned Equiniti acquisition and focus on stock issuers as key to its tokenization ambitions.

slots.title: Goldman Sachs, Citi among banks said to commit $270 million to stablecoin venture
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: The venture, known as Project Faro, plans to issue a dollar-denominated stablecoin and is expected to be incorporated in the U.S.

slots.title: Warren: What is White House doing to prevent a repeat of teleprompter's Trump bets?
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: U.S. Senator Elizabeth Warren argued the administration is not doing enough about staff insider trading, questioning whether CFTC enforcement action was sufficient.

slots.title: OpenAI acquires Odessia, travel startup created by Sonder founder
slots.author: TechCrunch
slots.summary: OpenAI has not yet said what its plans are for the future of travel. But Sonder founder Francis Davidson is a well-known figure in the travel industry.

slots.title: Oura to acquire AI-native primary care startup Counsel Health for $625M
slots.author: TechCrunch
slots.summary: The deal comes a few weeks after Oura postponed its up to $2.2 billion IPO indefinitely, citing “uncertainty in the IPO market.”

slots.title: OpenAI, Anthropic face new oversight as New York’s AI safety law takes effect
slots.author: TechCrunch
slots.summary: New York is preparing to enforce its sweeping AI safety law, requiring major developers like OpenAI and Anthropic to register, disclose safety practices, and report critical incidents or face fines.
